title: When uncertainty reaches the tongue
subtitle: For speech that spreads the fog before seeking light
description: These readings slow the mouth before doubt turns into needless suspicion, complaint, or confusion handed to others.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Guru’s word cools doubt before the tongue multiplies it.
heroSource.lifeApplication: If you are not clear, speak humbly enough that your uncertainty does not become another person’s burden.

evidence.coreClaim: This path catches doubt at the point where inner fog becomes public speech.
evidence.turn: Speech becomes safer when it waits for the Guru’s word to steady it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Say what you know, admit what you do not, and refuse to decorate uncertainty as wisdom.
